document: GitHub Actions secrets context map for AxiomicCoreness/hello_world.py
policy: GARDEN_SECRETS (plural) is not an environment variable. SUPERSECRET is not a name this repo reads. github_token is not a repository secret; use secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN. Secret material is supplied at runtime by Actions or the operator shell. This file records names, context expressions, sources, and consumers in full.

github_token.source: GitHub Actions automatically injects secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN for each job. It is not created with gh secret set. It is not a PAT stored in the repository.
github_token.example_step: gh issue --repo ${{ github.repository }} create --title "Issue title" --body "Issue body"

NPM_TOKEN.source: Not used. This repository publishes Python modules and GitHub Actions YAML. There is no npm publish job and no package.json release pipeline that reads NPM_TOKEN.

SUPERSECRET.source: Repository Actions secret named GARDEN_SECRET. Set with: gh secret set GARDEN_SECRET --repo AxiomicCoreness/hello_world.py
SUPERSECRET.server_reader: port380_mcp.py verify_garden_secret compares the header to os.getenv("GARDEN_SECRET") with hmac.compare_digest

MCP_URL.source: Repository Actions secret or ConfigMap. Not a credential; it is a URL. Stored as a secret so the pulse job can target whatever host is live without a code change.

MCP_CONNECTOR_URL.source: ConfigMap mcp-connector-config or process environment. Same origin as MCP_URL for the local-first gate.

strategy_context.meaning: strategy.job-index is the zero-based index of the current matrix combination. strategy.job-total is the number of combinations. matrix.target is the current endpoint name from the matrix list.

operator_set: gh secret set MCP_URL --repo AxiomicCoreness/hello_world.py --body http://127.0.0.1:380
